newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia Breweries to sell 10 pct shares to public.
newsitem.headline: Zambia Breweries to sell 10 pct shares to public.

text.p: Zambia Breweries is to sell 10 percent of its shares to the public next month ahead of its listing on the Lusaka Stock Exchange on June 9, a company official said on Friday.
The official said the shares, held by the Zambia Privatisation Trust Fund, would be on offer between April 21 and May 9.

"This 10 percent represents 13 million shares and these will be offered for sale between April 21 and May 9. A portion of these shares, not exceeding 1.3 million, will be cleared preferentially but at the same price per share to employees of Zambia Breweries," the official said.

The company expects to be listed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange on June 9, making it the sixth company to be listed on the exchange after Chilanga Cement, Farmers House, Rothmans, Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines and Zambia Sugar.

Zambia Breweries is owned by Zamanglo Industrial Corp, a local company through which Anglo American Corp of South Africa runs its investments in Zambia, and South African Breweries subsidiary Indol International. Each own 45 percent of the sharholding in Zambia Breweries.
